If you case is simple, save your money and do it yourself. You already have all the documentation so just open you account online and that is it. You can learn about the process with a step by step guide and ask questions in this group. From my own experience once I released my lawyer everything went much smoother.

https://aic.org.il/partner-visa-in-israel-step-by-step-guide-to-your-first-visa/
